name: Hermes Agent
description:
Connect Cortex XSOAR to Hermes Agent, an open-source self-hosted AI agent from
Nous Research. This pack provides the Hermes Agent integration, which lets a
playbook send an instruction together with incident data and read the reply -
and the record of every tool the agent called to produce it - back into the
playbook context, start a background run and collect it later with the built-in
GenericPolling playbook, or push a signed payload to a Hermes webhook route.
author: Nicholas Hsiao
